experiment: Qwengram-0.8B matched ParScale P=2 budget probe
aggregation: Linear(2048,1024), SiLU, Linear(1024,2); FP32 softmax; smoothing 0.01; official h-P feature order
full_attention: raw learned prefix KV after native Q/K norms and partial RoPE; original output gate and projection; all prefix slots visible
linear_attention: learned virtual KV before real tokens in native normalized Gated DeltaNet recurrence; virtual decay=0, beta=1; no virtual queries or convolution inputs
reader: share only raw memory rows; evaluate canonical reader and alpha8 on each stream hidden state
rounding: 100K, 500K and 1M rounded up to complete 512-token blocks
schedule_note: Fixed 5M horizon preserves resumability after quota reset; this probe is hard-capped at selected <=1M and launches no continuation
precision: FP16 frozen backbone; FP32 ParScale/reader/arbiter/CE; GradScaler; identical-token retries
initialization: zero prefix V; random linear prefix K; full-attention keys initialized by query-only minimax suppression on first 20 training blocks from both frozen baselines; zero final aggregation projection
training_objective: ordinary next-token CE; no teacher logits or auxiliary LM targets
